theorems.statement: ∀ (N N' : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid N)) 0), R.measure univ ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : (Euclid N → Euclid N') → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) 0, (∀ (F : Euclid N → Euclid N') (Λ : NNReal), LipschitzWith Λ F → IsIntegerMultiplicity (Y F) ∧ ∀ Fs : ℕ → Euclid N → Euclid N', (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Fs j)) → (∀ j, LipschitzWith Λ (Fs j)) → TendstoUniformly Fs F atTop → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) 0, Tendsto (fun j => R.action (fun x => ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') 0) (Fs j x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x))) atTop (𝓝 (Y F ω))) ∧ ∀ (F F' : Euclid N → Euclid N') (Λ : NNReal), LipschitzWith Λ F → LipschitzWith Λ F' → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[0].restrict R.carrier), F x = F' x) → Y F = Y F'
